name: Cloudflare capabilities
description: Web search, web fetch and the browser on Cloudflare through the oc-workers gate; no API key.

cliCommands.name: cf-capabilities
cliCommands.description: Cloudflare capabilities through the oc-host gate

webSearch.baseUrl.label: Capability gate URL
webSearch.baseUrl.help: Where the gate listens inside the container (default http://15.0.0.3). Web search and the browser status read use it. Live browser state: `openclaw cf-capabilities status`.

webFetch.baseUrl.label: Web fetch relay URL
webFetch.baseUrl.help: Loopback relay to the gate (default http://127.0.0.1:18791).
